Resolves #18880

🪢 *An arm of mine, merged two hours ago, reddened someone else's PR. It asserted something it was not about.*

`CellEditingExample.spec.mjs` › `date: Enter after a picker visit commits and hands focus back to the View` waited for the dying picker's container to leave the DOM before reading focus. On a loaded runner that node was seen to stay (PR #18857, run 35344690108, attempt 2, a ComboBox-only diff), and the arm failed on it. The assertion goes; the editor's removal — which lands after the picker's mount — stays as the barrier, with the focus read and the record read-back.

Evidence: L3 (real Chromium, CI-executed e2e tier) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-2). Residual: none.

Micro-review eligible: test-only — one assertion removed, one comment.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; the PR baseline jobs run in CI. Change class: zero-delta (`test`).
